title: ～上げる — to finish ～ completely
summary: When 上げる is attached to the ます-stem of a verb, it means to carry an action through to the end and complete it. It often implies effort and a satisfying result. It is used mainly in writing and in somewhat formal speech.

patterns.form: 動詞ます形の語幹 ＋ 上げる
patterns.gloss: Verb ます-stem + 上げる (e.g. 書き上げる, 作り上げる, 磨き上げる)

body.p: Compare 書く (write) with 書き上げる (write and complete). 上げる adds the idea of finishing the action fully and ending with a finished product. With ～終わる you only say the action ended; with ～上げる you also feel that it was done carefully and completed.
It combines with verbs that make something: 書く, 作る, 仕立てる, 仕上げる, 磨く, 織る. It is a set compound, so you learn each combination as a word (書き上げる, 作り上げる, 磨き上げる, 育て上げる) rather than making new ones freely.

It fits a person who has worked hard to finish a piece of work, a report, a craft or a skill. It is often used in the past tense to report an achievement. Note that 上げる is a transitive verb, so the person doing the action is the subject and the thing finished takes を.

examples.ja: レポートを書（か）き上（あ）げました。
examples.note: 書く → 書き + 上げる: the report is written through to the end.

examples.ja: 職人（しょくにん）が一年（いちねん）かけて、この家具（かぐ）を作（つく）り上（あ）げた。
examples.romaji: Shokunin ga ichinen kakete, kono kagu o tsukuriageta.
examples.tr: The craftsman spent a year and completed this piece of furniture.
examples.note: The long time (一年かけて) fits the sense of carefully finishing.

examples.ja: 彼女（かのじょ）は古（ふる）い車（くるま）をぴかぴかに磨（みが）き上（あ）げた。
examples.romaji: Kanojo wa furui kuruma o pikapika ni migakiageta.
examples.tr: She polished the old car until it was sparkling clean.
examples.note: The result is stated with ぴかぴかに: polished until it shines.

pitfalls: Attach it to the ます-stem (書き上げる), not the te-form. Do not confuse it with 上がる (to rise / to be completed by itself), as in 出来上がる.
It is a fixed compound. Not every verb can be used with 上げる, so check each one as a word (for example, 食べ上げる is not natural).
